The existing site, its operator and status are not established in the Atlas, so it is unclear whether this would be a new site or a project at a campus that should first be added.
entries.reopen_condition: Identify the existing data center site and its status from a dated primary record, then add the site (or Building 4 as a project on it) with an official parcel or application-polygon locator.

entries.candidate: Dulles Electric Data Centers, Loudoun County (site plan EPLAN-2024-0154; consolidation plat PLAT-2026-0121 of 12 August 2026; bonds PBOND-2026-0150/0151 of 5 October 2026; waterline revision EPLAN-2026-0145 of 23 September 2026)
entries.reason: In-window plat, bond and plan-revision records name the Dulles Electric Data Centers project and its 2024 site plan, but none states the number of buildings or an approval date; they are ancillary records. Three-change limit.
entries.reopen_condition: Capture EPLAN-2024-0154 and its polygon, plus LandMARC permits on the consolidated parcel; admit as announced, or as permitted from a dated site-plan approval or building permit in the window.

entries.candidate: Belmont Innovation Campus Buildings 1, 2 and 5, Loudoun County (EPLAN-2025-0195; performance and proffer bonds PBOND-2026-0119 and PBOND-2026-0120 filed 4 August 2026)
entries.reason: Bonds of 4 August 2026 name Belmont Innovation Campus Buildings 1, 2 and 5 under site plan EPLAN-2025-0195; the bond text does not say they are data centers, although LandMARC shows core-and-shell trade permits for an 'SDC Belmont Building 3 (Blackfin)'. Data-centre use and the campus identity were not confirmed.
entries.reopen_condition: A county record stating the data-centre use of the Belmont buildings, with the EPLAN-2025-0195 polygon; a dated building permit or completion for Building 3 would support a separate project.

entries.candidate: 110 Terminal Drive Data Center, Loudoun County (EPLAN-2024-0105; easement plats PLAT-2026-0128 and PLAT-2026-0130 of 20 and 25 August 2026)
entries.reason: Easement plats are ancillary records for the 2024 site plan; the plan's scope and approval were not reviewed.
entries.reopen_condition: Capture EPLAN-2024-0105 and parcel permits; admit as announced or permitted from a dated site-plan approval or building permit.

entries.candidate: AWS Building 081 addition, 42949 Fadeley Lane, Loudoun County (EPLAN-2026-0116, 11 August 2026; 14,177 sq ft footprint addition to an existing data center)
entries.reason: A minor addition to an existing data center building that is not in the Atlas; the existing facility's own status is not established by a dated primary source, and an addition of this size would be better added as a project once the host facility is admitted.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated primary record of the existing Building 081 operation (or of the addition's permit or completion) with a parcel locator.

entries.candidate: Twin Creeks Buildings 1-3, Loudoun County (EPLAN-2026-0111, data center buildings 1-3; filed 29 July 2026)
entries.reason: The site-plan filing of 29 July 2026 is four days before the 85-day admission window (2 August 2026). Later in-window Twin Creeks records are trade permits for Building 5 (see the 26 October LandMARC hold) and substation special exceptions, which are not development consent for Buildings 1-3.
entries.reopen_condition: An in-window dated record for Buildings 1-3 (site-plan approval, building permit or bond naming them), with the EPLAN-2026-0111 polygon locator.

entries.candidate: Prince William County pending data-centre planning cases transmitted before the window (Six Towers Industrial Park REZ2026-00019; Manassas Corporate Center 8 REZ2026-00032; Atlantic Funding Development REZ2026-00041/SUP2026-00033; Southgate South REZ2026-00044/SUP2026-00035; Project Industry REZ2025-00003; University Business Park REZ2023-00019; Ashton (Vulcan) REZ2022-00031; Sudley Manor Drive Amazon Data Services REZ2026-00039)
entries.reason: All are listed on the county's Pending Planning Cases layer on 26 October 2026, but their transmittal dates (November 2025 to June 2026 or earlier) are older than the 85-day window, and no in-window hearing or decision record was accessible (the county's document host and website answer HTTP 403 to robots.txt).
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Planning Commission or Board decision, a new concurrent application transmitted in the window, or a site-plan or building-permit record, with the case polygon as locator.

entries.candidate: Loudoun LandMARC submitted permits and Prince William use-permit re-check (26 October 2026)
entries.reason: The Loudoun submitted-permits table (snapshot 26 October) holds no pending commercial new-construction building permit applied for since 25 July 2026; data-centre items are alterations and fit-outs of existing buildings. The Prince William use-permit layer shows no data-centre special use permit approved since 1 July 2026; NCU2027-00032 'DATA CENTER USE' (9 October) is a nonconforming-use certification, as recorded by us-va-p1.
entries.reopen_condition: A new building permit application or approval for a named data-centre building, or a data-centre SUP approval, dated in the window.
